_comment: Speeds keep a 30:20:18:35:22 ratio, scaled so a Scooter 10 sails Rome-Tunis in about 60 s. range_nm is the longest single leg the model can sail (Scooter 10: 1 min 30 s of sailing, GE 100: 3 min 30 s, Greenline 200: 6 min, Trans Atlantic: any Med port to the US East Coast, Dominator: the longest route between any two ports). max_owned is how many of each model the player can own. map_size (length, width in pixels) and map_color are how the ship is drawn on the map.
